Buy a Residence Permit via Telegram: how the transaction works

Most UK residence permit sellers work through a channel that posts stock and a chat that closes the sale. The channel is marketing. The chat is where you find out whether the person knows the document.

Keep the photos the seller sends. When the parcel arrives, photograph the unopened envelope before you open it, then the document beside the envelope. That sequence ties the document to the seller.

Who actually issues a Residence Permit

The UK residence permit is a state product made by the Home Office. Replicas copy the look, registered originals carry a number in the office records, and both are sold on Telegram as if they were the same thing.

Number formats are the one part of this that a buyer can always test without equipment. Look up the format for the United Kingdom and compare digit by digit. It takes a minute and settles most arguments.

Replica or registered original

If the card only has to look right across a counter, a print is enough and the bottom of the band is fair. If a number has to be looked up, pay the top and make the seller prove the lookup first.

This is the single most useful distinction on the page, because it explains the price spread better than anything else. A quote tells you which tier the seller thinks you are in.

What a fair price looks like

Price is the easiest thing to compare and the least informative. Two adverts at the same figure can differ completely in stock, number and delivery, and the figure shows you none of it.

The table below splits the band into the three tiers so you can see what each figure is actually for. Read it before you open a chat and you will not anchor on whatever number the seller opens with.

The buying process, step by step

The steps below are deliberately boring. Boring is what a UK residence permit purchase should feel like.

  1. Ask which office issued it and confirm the answer is the Home Office.
  2. Request an uncropped photo of the full card on a plain surface with the laminate edge in frame.
  3. Request a UV shot of the data page and a close crop of the number field.
  4. Test the number against the format the Home Office uses. A number that breaks the format ends the deal.
  5. Agree a price inside the 250–800 GBP band and pay in two parts, deposit then balance against tracking.
  6. On arrival check the document against the photos before you accept delivery and photograph the unopened envelope.

Checks that catch bad stock

These are the tests that matter for a UK residence permit. The two local ones are worth memorising.

  • Check the DVLA or DVA hologram and confirm the licence number encodes the surname, which is the numbering rule.
  • Confirm the issue date on the photocard against the record the seller shows for it.
  • Check the number format against the published rule for the Home Office. Constructed numbers cannot be invented by hand.
  • Look for the UV print with a 365 nanometre torch. Real ink is sharp and placed deliberately. A print shows a dull bloom or nothing.
  • Loupe the microprint and the ghost image. Both collapse into a dotted line or a grey patch on a photocopy.
  • Compare the data across every field for internal consistency. A postcode that contradicts the state or the office area is a tell.
  • Check the laminate or polycarbonate edge for a fused seal rather than a cut line under a laid sheet.

Red flags that should end the conversation

If you see any of these, stop paying attention to the price.

  • A driving licence that uses the American spelling on the card face.
  • The seller cannot name the issuing office, only the country.
  • The number breaks the published format, or is round and repeating.

Frequently asked questions

What does a residence permit cost on Telegram?

Between 300 and 1400 US dollars. The permit number and the register entry carry most of the value.

How is it different from a visa?

A visa gets you in. A permit lets you stay. They are issued by different offices and checked differently.

Does it replace a green card?

Outside the United States it is the equivalent tier below permanent residence, not a replacement for it.

Why so expensive?

Because the number has to sit in an immigration register to be worth anything, and that is the hardest part to fake.

What is the common failure?

A permit class that sounds plausible but does not exist in the country scheme. Check the class list first.

Before you pay

If you have a UK residence permit in front of you and something feels off, compare it against the list above before you send anything.
